Package com.irurueta.navigation.inertial.calibration

Class TedaldiCalibrationEndToEndTest

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.navigation.inertial.calibration.TedaldiCalibrationEndToEndTest
class TedaldiCalibrationEndToEndTest extends Object
End-to-end test of the IMU calibration pipeline following the procedure described in Tedaldi et al., "A robust and easy to implement method for IMU calibration without external equipments", ICRA 2014: an initial static period followed by a set of static positions separated by slow and fast rotations.

Synthetic data is generated with a known error model (upper triangular accelerometer scale factors and cross couplings, general gyroscope scale factors and cross couplings, biases and white noise), processed by the measurements generator and calibrated with the default norm-based accelerometer calibrator and the default easy gyroscope calibrator. All random data is seeded so that the test is fully deterministic.
